description: What the main window may use: Tauri's core defaults; dragging and titling the window, and closing it after asking about unsaved edits; the open and save dialogs; reading the clipboard's text, for Paste as Plain Text; the five file commands the app calls (read a file, list a folder, write a text file, watch and unwatch) on the home folder and everything in it except hidden files and folders, with the file plugin's denials of the webview's own data; and checking for, downloading and installing an update, which the updater verifies with the public key in tauri.conf.json. A file picked in an open or save dialog is added to the scope by the dialog plugin, wherever it is.
